review: Inspected the exact exported GLB: yellow rounded triangular body, smooth black round frames, both original curved closed eyes, no duplicate baked ring remnants in front and three-quarter views. Seven neutral directions and clay front/three-quarter/back distinguish frame shadows from albedo. Viewed all seven clip examples from front/side/back; the connected frame remains aligned under hop, squash and tilt. Full-vertex main/LOD 120 Hz checks, viewer controls and 70 clip/direction/speed observations pass. Game integration is still pending.
gameVisualReview: Inspected all four new held bots on the actual character hand; each preserves its distinct outline, face and accessories. All nine kinds complete synchronized windup, airborne, landing, return and reunion on five clients. Rear-camera supplemental images show the beret and heart visibly in flight and the frog back in formation; all four projected airborne centres are inside the screen. All nine player rigs, distant LOD and non-empty-inventory reload pass. Three screen sizes retain 33 unobstructed control targets.
